events.description: Musyj serves as VP Corporate Services and Medical Affairs at WRH
events.quote:
I served as the Vice President of Corporate Services and Medical Affairs of the WRH from 
2000-2007.

events.description: Musyj becomes President and CEO of Windsor Regional Hospital
events.quote: I have held this position since 2007.

events.description: WRH's pre-Bill 7 $600 daily rate for patients refusing an LTC placement
events.quote:
WRH had a similar internal policy in place where a patient who was 
accepted to an LTC home, but refused to leave the hospital, would be subject to a $600 daily rate

events.description: Bill 7 requires a standardized $400 daily rate after a 24-hour waiting period
events.quote: there is now a requirement that hospitals charge a standardized rate of $400

events.description: Ontario Health issues operational directions on rehab/CCC capacity and fall/winter readiness
events.quote: there is active work ongoing province wide to provide better access to care

events.description: Bill 7 changes place 15 WRH ALC patients in HCCSS-selected LTC homes
events.quote: In 2023, the changes under Bill 7 facilitated the placement of 15 WRH ALC patients
